'''''Triple Threat''''' was a proposed novel by [[Timothy Zahn]], [[Michael A. Stackpole|Michael Stackpole]], and [[Aaron Allston]]. It was described as a 'braided novel' by Allston and as a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triptych 'triptych]' by Zahn. The novel would have followed three generations of the [[Horn family]] in an overarching story divided into three eras, with each author contributing their part of the story to the novel. It was proposed to [[Lucasfilm]] and [[Del Rey]] in 2012, but due to the sale of Lucasfilm and the decision to cease publishing novels set in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]/Legends timeline, the project was abandoned.<ref name=":0">{{Reddit|url=r/StarWarsEU/comments/17cjzqi/authors_timothy_zahn_michael_stackpole_and_aaron|thread=Authors Timothy Zahn, Michael Stackpole, and Aaron Allston discuss their never-made, three-part novel 'Triple Threat,' which would have followed three generations of the Horn family [2013]|user=xezene|date=2023-10-22}}</ref>
